_meta.purpose: SSOT registry for the unified reset + key-switch safety contract (op#14474). One row per fleet body: which launcher, dir, tmux session, token pointer, model pointer, singleton flag, resume mode, boot role. Front doors (reset / switch-account) resolve a body -> its row; the shared gate lib (scripts/lib/reset_gates.sh) enforces the same gates for every row. This file is CONFIGURATION, not code — dep-free JSON so both bash (jq/python) and python parse it.
_meta.phase: 0 — registry + gate lib + tests only; NOTHING reads this live yet (zero behaviour change). Wiring is Phase 1+.
_meta.verified: hosts, launchers, dirs, tmux sessions, token pointers, resume modes confirmed from boot_*.sh + live `tmux ls` + .env on 2026-08-18.
_meta.todo_confirm: model_pointer for cc-orchestrator and cc-fleet-health (no per-body .*_model pointer exists; they fall back to boot default / .fleet_model) — confirm intended source during Phase 1. token pointers on the hub live on the VPS filesystem, not the Mini.
_meta.pointer_semantics: token_pointer / model_pointer name the DURABLE on-disk file whose CONTENT is the desired account/model. Desired state = pointer content; running state = live process (fp for account, running model for model). G8 drift = desired != running.

cai.notes: agent_id='cai' EXACTLY, no sub-tag (CAI-RESP-254). --resume folds in per CAI-RESP-1147; do NOT route through switch_lane_token.

cc-orchestrator.notes: VPS-resident (wingmen-core). Token pointer + dir are on the VPS filesystem. --continue (NOT --resume, which parks at an interactive picker). Currently in NEITHER switch tool — made first-class in Phase 3 (GATED on cai lease sign-off).

cc-fleet-health.notes: agent_id='cc-fleet-health' EXACTLY, no sub-tag. No per-body model pointer; falls back to boot default.

orch-console.notes: Nazim (console body). Model via NAZIM_MODEL env (.env), not a pointer file. Model switch = set NAZIM_MODEL + kill-session -> waiter fresh-restarts (not in-place /clear).

_lane_template.notes: TEMPLATE, not a body. Lanes need family/sub-tag allocation (auto_agent_id). Default token pointer is per-FAMILY (known gap: can't persist a single-lane move — proposal #30). Model pointer per-session .<lane>_model overrides .fleet_model.
